hypotheses.C0_manual_program_matches_native: The native branch matches checkpoint logits with maximum absolute error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.C1_typed128_recovers_suffix_behavior: Fine-128 recovers at least 80 percent of local-attention deletion KL at every layer.
hypotheses.C2_typed32_is_behaviorally_useful: Fine-32 recovers at least 50 percent of deletion KL in at least four layers.
hypotheses.C3_local_operator_recovery_predicts_suff: Across layer-method cells, Spearman correlation between local-operator and suffix-KL recovery is at least 0.70.
hypotheses.C4_broader_closures_preserve_behavior: At every layer, at least one 32-type closure matches or exceeds fine-32 KL recovery.
hypotheses.C5_middle_layers_remain_broader_behavior: Mean fine-32 KL recovery at Layers 2-4 is at least 0.15 below Layers 0, 1, and 5.
